title: Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs
subtitle: A new assignment across the islands
summary: Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs is Creatures' third Nintendo DS adventure about befriending Pokémon through the Capture Styler. Set in the island region of Oblivia, it follows the Ranger's efforts to stop the Pokémon Pinchers, with a ukulele-playing Pichu as a companion. The familiar loop-drawing action returns alongside new symbols that summon legendary helpers. The islands give those partnerships a larger physical role in travel. body: Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs is Creatures' third Nintendo DS adventure about befriending Pokémon through the Capture Styler. Set in the island region of Oblivia, it follows the Ranger's efforts to stop the Pokémon Pinchers, with a ukulele-playing Pichu as a companion. The familiar loop-drawing action returns alongside new symbols that summon legendary helpers. The islands give those partnerships a larger physical role in travel. A creature's help can now become a way of crossing the region as well as overcoming the obstacle directly in front of the Ranger.

Drawing the appropriate Guardian Sign summons a Legendary Pokémon such as Raikou, Entei or Suicune for use outside captures. The gesture connects a remembered pattern to a particular form of help. Ordinary encounters still ask for circles around moving targets, with attacks threatening the Styler's energy and experience improving its capabilities. The new signs add another kind of drawing to that familiar routine. Instead of only tracing around what is already visible, the player can use a symbol to call a useful presence into the journey.

Separate cooperative missions allow up to four players to take part together, extending the Ranger idea beyond the main single-player story. Pokémon can also be brought into a capture to provide support, so help is represented through both the creatures and other human participants. The ukulele Pichu gives the main journey a distinctive travelling companion. Guardian Signs develops the series through these different scales of cooperation: a small ally at the Ranger's side, a legendary mount for the wider region and a group of players working through a shared assignment.

A sign calls a legendary partner
An assignment that can be shared
